reason: My relative in India can sort this out for free, and I compare everything to the paisa. Paying CAD $149-199 on top of the bank's rate to move a sum my family could help me with does not add up for me.
objection: I can get the same paperwork done through my relative and a local CA for much less, and I have no reason to trust a new company with lakhs when I can't see what the bank's rate really costs me.
would_change_my_mind: A fee under about CAD $60 for 10 lakh, plus proof the partner bank's rate is no worse than what my own bank gives, or my relative being unable to handle it.
